gen-press-start-2p-gf-comme: Comme fills its lines with lowercase bodies that take up most of the letter height, and the curves stay open and smooth. And Press Start 2P, pinned-apart like cut-out letters, wants a bigger size than the sans beneath it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-cossette-texte: Chunky, cut-out letters spaced far apart give Press Start 2P its retro grin, with strokes that lead the eye without taking over. Cossette Texte follows with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a tall x-height, a plain sans that feels like following one thread.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-duru-sans: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P lets its mellow thick-thin shifts and far-apart letters do the talking up top. But Duru Sans earns its keep below, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate each line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-fresca: Pixel-bright and a bit cheeky, Press Start 2P keeps its modulation quiet and its bowls big. And Fresca settles beneath it as a plain sans with flat stroke weight, short ascenders and counters that stay open to the outside.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-funnel-sans: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P brings hairlines that are present but never razor thin to the top of the page. Yet Funnel Sans runs true monoline underneath, its e opened like a pried clasp, so the sans-serif text feels crisp against the heading's play.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-gafata: Letters pinned far apart like cut-out shapes make Press Start 2P instantly retro, with only faint stress between stem and hairline. Gafata does the quieter job, a tall band of sans letters with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-geist: Geist reads as a quiet, level line, its openings wide as a sprung paper clip and its words forming solid blocks. And Press Start 2P adds a faint crayon-on-rough-paper rhythm above it, so the plain sans gets a playful, retro frame.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-georama: Georama is a sans with barely rising capitals. Its wide-open c looks like a bracelet pulled apart, so a long passage would move along smoothly beneath the chunky, far-spaced Press Start 2P heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-gidole: Gidole reads like neon glass, every stroke drawn as one tube. Its terminals stay apart like open scissor blades and its midline sits high, which makes it a lively partner for the light contrast of Press Start 2P.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-golos-text: Far-apart, cut-out spacing and moderate thick and thin strokes give Press Start 2P its fun, retro bite. But Golos Text goes the other way, a sans-serif like a bent paperclip, with an x-height that fills the line.
